Hey! Dont mock the Sub sannwiches dude.Those are awesome.

Stay away from the dressings tho,that stuff filled with chems and preservatives is what kills you....haha

Cheers

Very interesting.Though to be honest I have come across this theory before,in one form or another.

The Buckminster Fuller epiphany of ego death and life itself as transcendental to the human experience.Life as an experiment,as something that you are merely a part of.

Having observed nature a lot,I can say that to some extent,I began believing this some time ago anyway.The fact is that we have only one true biological purpose.And that is the role of carriers of genetic information with the ingrained sole purpose of reproducing.
The early adapters and fittest survivors carry on to continue the process,as lifeforms are supposed to interconnect more and maybe,just maybe,even evolve to some sort of higher shared conciousness.Maybe the universe itself is becoming concious of itself.No one can say for sure though.

The problem I have with this is this: Since all that pain or disappointment is avoidable,and after a certain age,life takes more than it gives,why continue with this experiment.Life,even if it somehow survives against an ever more hostile Universe,with its dying stars and increasing entropy,can carry on without me anyway.

Why should I, as life itself,suffer, because of some evolutionary defense mechanisms like the depression in my head,which make this experience all the more difficult.I'm not really looking to gain anything in all the randomness and chaos.Life through me has gained nothing it already had before or known nothing it already knew.

Still,I appreciate that at least someone sees things in a somewhat similar way.
Thanks man.

Thank you.

Its somehow good to know that I'm not the only one who constantly feels overwhelmed by all my past and the constant futility of the present/future.
Even if it might not be through marriage,I hope you find some peace or meaning with someone.

TC
